turns.q: I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.
turns.replyTail:
That makes total sense, especially if you’ve been let down by similar pieces before. Our waterproof line uses 14K or 18K gold or silver plating over brass or stainless steel with an added anti-tarnish layer. The pieces are shower-safe, sweat-safe, nickel-free, and hypoallergenic, but the plating can wear over time with perfume, lotion, chlorine, or cleaning products.

Which product are you considering? I can walk you through its materials and care details so you can choose confidently 💖
